preconditions.description: The number of lines in the file is between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= a_i <= 10**5 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each line contains between 0 and 100,000 characters.
The starting and ending line numbers are within the range of the number of lines.
The starting and ending cursor positions are within the valid range for their respective lines.

postconditions.expression: return_value == min_moves(r1, c1, r2, c2, a)
postconditions.description: The output is the minimum number of key presses required to move the cursor from (r1, c1) to (r2, c2).
